services.title: Wallet token balances
services.semantics: Exact ERC-20 balances of one wallet for a bounded token list, all read at the same Arc block. USDC is read through its ERC-20 interface (6 decimals), not the 18-decimal native balance.

tokens.description: Tokens to read. Omit to read the default list (USDC, TOLLY).

successConditions: Every requested token appears exactly once, in balances or in errors.
All values come from one block, identified by number and hash.
services.refundPolicy: If payment settles and no result can be delivered or recovered, the full price is refunded on chain.
services.redistribution: Buyer may use and redistribute the result; it is public on-chain data.
limitations: Only the listed tokens are read; this is not a full portfolio. Full holdings need the indexer (wallet.intelligence.v1).
No USD values in v1.

services.title: Arc market search
services.semantics: Filter and sort Arc mainnet token/USDC markets that traded in the last 7 days, from our own index of the trusted V3 factories and the V4 PoolManager. Volumes are the USDC side of swaps (USDC = $1). volume_acceleration = volume_1h / (volume_24h / 24), null when volume_24h < $100. liquidity_usdc is the USDC held by a V3 pool; it is null for V4 markets (not attributable).

liquidity_min.description: Minimum USDC liquidity (excludes markets where it is unknown)

successConditions: Every number comes from the index at the stated block; unknown values are null with a reason.
Results are limited to markets with at least one swap in the last 7 days.
services.refundPolicy: If payment settles and no result can be delivered or recovered, the full price is refunded on chain.
services.redistribution: Buyer may use and redistribute the result; it is derived from public on-chain data.
limitations: Token/USDC markets only; token/token pairs and V2-style pools are not covered yet.
V4 liquidity is null: the PoolManager pools funds, so per-market USDC is not attributable from balances.
Market cap = totalSupply × price; it does not exclude burned or locked supply.
Markets valued above 10,000× their liquidity (or, where liquidity is unknown, above 10,000× their 24 h volume) are flagged and hidden unless include_flagged is set.
Zero-fee and hooked pools are flagged: their volume can be generated without economic cost.
Windows: volume_1h/volume_24h include every 5-minute bucket overlapping the window; change_24h compares with the last price before the 24 h window.

services.title: Arc market search
services.semantics: Filter and sort Arc mainnet token/USDC markets that traded in the last 7 days, from our own index of the trusted V3 factories and the V4 PoolManager. Volumes are the USDC side of swaps (USDC = $1). volume_acceleration = volume_1h / (volume_24h / 24), null when volume_24h < $100. liquidity_usdc is the USDC held by a V3 pool, or for a V4 market the USDC its liquidity positions hold between the current price and half of it (what a seller can take out before the token's price halves); liquidity_note says which.

liquidity_min.description: Minimum USDC liquidity (excludes markets where it is unknown)

successConditions: Every number comes from the index at the stated block; unknown values are null with a reason.
Results are limited to markets with at least one swap in the last 7 days.
services.refundPolicy: If payment settles and no result can be delivered or recovered, the full price is refunded on chain.
services.redistribution: Buyer may use and redistribute the result; it is derived from public on-chain data.
limitations: Token/USDC markets only; token/token pairs and V2-style pools are not covered yet.

V4 liquidity counts only real position liquidity within the half-price band (read every ~15 minutes for the 400 busiest V4 markets of the last 8 days; others, and those that left that set, are null with liquidity_note not_measured_yet). Pools whose hooks price swaps themselves, or block or tax other traders, can trade differently from their positions.
Market cap = totalSupply × price; it does not exclude burned or locked supply.
Markets valued above 10,000× their liquidity (or, where liquidity is unknown, above 10,000× their 24 h volume) are flagged and hidden unless include_flagged is set.
Zero-fee and hooked pools are flagged: their volume can be generated without economic cost.
Windows: volume_1h/volume_24h include every 5-minute bucket overlapping the window; change_24h compares with the last price before the 24 h window.

services.title: Token intelligence report
services.semantics: One Arc mainnet token: supply, price (from its most traded token/USDC market with at least $1,000 of USDC depth), market cap, every indexed token/USDC market with liquidity and 24 h volume, its pools against other tokens (identity), launch facts, and holder metrics (count, top-1/top-10 share, HHI, top holders) from the full Transfer history, checked against totalSupply and balanceOf; computed during the call when the token is not indexed yet.
successConditions: Every number comes from our index or the chain at a stated block; unknown values are null.
Holder metrics are present only when the token's full Transfer history is indexed.
services.refundPolicy: If payment settles and no result can be delivered or recovered, the full price is refunded on chain.
services.redistribution: Buyer may use and redistribute the result; it is derived from public on-chain data.
limitations: Prices come from token/USDC markets on the indexed venues (USDC = $1); token/token markets are not covered.
Market cap = totalSupply × price; burned or locked supply is not subtracted.
No price is stated when no market has $1,000 of measured USDC depth (V4 depth is not measured, except the TOLLY pad's own pool).
Holder metrics are refused ('failed') for tokens whose Transfer history does not add up to totalSupply (rebasing, fee-on-transfer edge cases, non-standard events).
Holder metrics for a token we do not index yet are computed during the call when its history fits in ~4 s of reads; otherwise the answer says 'queued' and the token is indexed (paid calls only).
Pools against other tokens are listed (up to 20, newest first) without prices or volume.

services.title: Token intelligence report
services.semantics: One Arc mainnet token: supply, price (from its most traded token/USDC market with at least $1,000 of USDC depth; for V4 markets the USDC their positions hold between the price and half of it), market cap, every indexed token/USDC market with liquidity and 24 h volume, its pools against other tokens (identity), launch facts, and holder metrics (count, top-1/top-10 share, HHI, top holders) from the full Transfer history, checked against totalSupply and balanceOf; computed during the call when the token is not indexed yet.

No price is stated when no market has $1,000 of measured USDC depth. V4 depth is measured every ~15 minutes for the 400 busiest V4 markets (others count as unmeasured, except the TOLLY pad's own pool). V4 markets with a hook (other than the TOLLY pad's) or a zero fee show their depth but never set the price: a hook can block or tax other traders.
Holder metrics are refused ('failed') for tokens whose Transfer history does not add up to totalSupply (rebasing, fee-on-transfer edge cases, non-standard events).
Holder metrics for a token we do not index yet are computed during the call when its history fits in ~4 s of reads; otherwise the answer says 'queued' and the token is indexed (paid calls only).
Pools against other tokens are listed (up to 20, newest first) without prices or volume.

services.title: Risk / evidence report
services.semantics: Verifiable observations about one Arc mainnet token at a pinned block: contract and proxy facts (EIP-1967/EIP-1167), owner(), privileged functions found in the bytecode, V4 hook permissions of its pools, liquidity, age, launch facts and holder concentration. A separate, labelled interpretation is derived from those facts by fixed rules.
successConditions: Every chain read is made at the stated block.
Interpretation notes are derived only from the observations in the same answer.
services.refundPolicy: If payment settles and no result can be delivered or recovered, the full price is refunded on chain.
services.redistribution: Buyer may use and redistribute the result; it is derived from public on-chain data.
limitations: Privileged functions are found by their 4-byte selectors in the bytecode: a renamed function is missed, a selector used to call ANOTHER contract also matches, and a match does not prove who may call it.
Proxies are recognised by EIP-1967 (incl. beacon), EIP-1822, OpenZeppelin legacy slots, EIP-1167 clones and diamondCut; other upgrade schemes are not detected.

Transfer taxes are not simulated; V4 hooks that can take a cut are shown by their return-delta permissions. Anyone can open a hooked pool for any token, so hook notes only consider pools with >= 10% of the 24 h volume or the launch pool (up to 20 hooked pools are listed).
LP lock/burn status is not checked yet.
Interpretation is generated by fixed rules, is not advice and is not a guarantee.

services.title: Wallet intelligence
services.semantics: One Arc mainnet wallet: exact balances, all read at one block, for every token found for it (tokens whose holders we index + tokens it received in the last ~8 days + USDC and TOLLY), USD values from markets with at least $1,000 of measured USDC depth (not counted when the holding is worth over 10x that depth), its token transfers of the last ~24 h, and the TOLLY pad launches it created. Coverage, including any balance that could not be read, is stated with every answer.
successConditions: Every balance is read at the stated block; zero balances are omitted and unreadable ones are listed.
A USD value is stated only with a price from a market with at least $1,000 of measured USDC depth.
services.refundPolicy: If payment settles and no result can be delivered or recovered, the full price is refunded on chain.
services.redistribution: Buyer may use and redistribute the result; it is derived from public on-chain data.
limitations: Not a complete portfolio: a token is found only if we index its holders or the wallet received it in the last ~8 days (stated in coverage).
At most 150 tokens are read; very busy wallets may get partial discovery or activity (coverage.partial).
Infrastructure addresses (zero/burn, USDC, PoolManager, pads, routers) are refused before any price is quoted.

LP positions: Arc V3 (NonfungiblePositionManager) and Uniswap v4 (PositionManager, found by the position NFTs ever sent to the wallet) at the pool's current price; Synthra positions are not covered. V3 'owed' is only what the position already recorded (tokensOwed), V4 uncollected fees are not included.
An LP position's USD value uses the same deep-market prices as balances; positions with an unpriced token have no value.
Native USDC is reported once, through its ERC-20 interface (6 decimals).

services.title: Best execution quote
services.semantics: Exact-input quote on Arc mainnet across every V3 fee tier of Arc V3 and Synthra (direct and two hops through USDC), the busiest V4 pools against USDC (ERC-20 or native) and direct V4 token/token pools, each by the venue's own quoter at one pinned block. Returns every route, the best one, its price impact, and, when a recipient is given, UNSIGNED approval and swap transactions for the best route (V3: SwapRouter02; V4: Universal Router with Permit2) with a deadline and the slippage minimum, simulated from the recipient at the same block. Never executes.

recipient.description: Receives the output and signs the swap. Needed for calldata.

successConditions: Every route is quoted by its venue's quoter at the stated block.
Calldata pays the stated recipient, never anyone else, and reverts below amount_out_min_raw or after the deadline.
services.refundPolicy: If payment settles and no result can be delivered or recovered, the full price is refunded on chain.
services.redistribution: Buyer may use and redistribute the result.
limitations: A quote is a read at one block; the executed amount can differ (bounded by amount_out_min_raw).

Routes: direct V3 pools on all fee tiers, two V3 hops through USDC on the same venue, up to 5 direct V4 pools against USDC (ERC-20 or native), and up to 5 direct V4 token/token pools. Longer and mixed V3/V4 routes are not considered.
Native USDC routes take or pay the 18-decimal native balance (the same funds as the 6-decimal ERC-20 view): the swap value / amount_out_min_raw are then in 18 decimals.

V4 swaps through the Universal Router need two approvals for an ERC-20 input (token -> Permit2, Permit2 -> router; returned when missing). The router returns no amount, so a V4 simulation says only that the exact transaction executes.
Fee-on-transfer and other non-standard tokens can make the quoted amount unreachable.
V4 pools are quoted only without a hook, from pools.trade, or with a hook verified by a TOLLY hook registry (other hooks can game a quoter).
Route amounts are in the output token's ERC-20 units (amount_out_decimals); a native-USDC route's amount_out_min_raw and value are in 18 decimals.
price_impact_pct describes price_impact_route, the route that executes.

services.title: Best execution quote
services.semantics: Exact-input quote on Arc mainnet across every V3 fee tier of Arc V3 and Synthra (direct and two hops through USDC), the busiest V4 pools against USDC (ERC-20 or native), direct V4 token/token pools, and mixed two-hop routes through USDC that combine an Arc V3 pool and a V4 pool (or two V4 pools), each hop by its venue's own quoter at one pinned block. Returns every route with its hops, the best one, its price impact, and, when a recipient is given, UNSIGNED approval and swap transactions for the best route (V3: SwapRouter02; V4 and mixed: Universal Router with Permit2, one transaction) with a deadline and the slippage minimum on the final output, simulated from the recipient at the same block. Never executes.

recipient.description: Receives the output and signs the swap. Needed for calldata.

successConditions: Every route is quoted by its venue's quoter at the stated block.
Calldata pays the stated recipient, never anyone else, and reverts below amount_out_min_raw or after the deadline.
services.refundPolicy: If payment settles and no result can be delivered or recovered, the full price is refunded on chain.
services.redistribution: Buyer may use and redistribute the result.
limitations: A quote is a read at one block; the executed amount can differ (bounded by amount_out_min_raw).

Routes: direct V3 pools on all fee tiers, two V3 hops through USDC on the same venue, up to 5 direct V4 pools against USDC (ERC-20 or native), up to 5 direct V4 token/token pools, and mixed routes through ERC-20 USDC: of the first hops (Arc V3 pools on all fee tiers, and up to 3 allowed V4 pools among the 15 busiest), the best Arc V3 one and the best V4 one, each followed by up to 3 such V4 pools (and Arc V3 pools after a V4 hop). quote_failures counts the other routes; failed single-hop quotes of mixed routes are only noted. Synthra hops are never mixed (the Universal Router only knows the Arc V3 factory). Longer routes are not considered.

A mixed route's amount is hop 2 quoted with hop 1's quoted output at the same block; only the final output has a minimum (the whole route is one transaction and reverts below it). USDC left in the router by a partly filled V3 hop 2 is returned to the recipient in the same transaction. Its gas_estimate is the hops' quoter estimates summed (router overhead not included); hooks shows the first hook on the route (each hop's is in legs).
Native USDC routes take or pay the 18-decimal native balance (the same funds as the 6-decimal ERC-20 view): the swap value / amount_out_min_raw are then in 18 decimals.

V4 and mixed swaps through the Universal Router need two approvals for an ERC-20 input (token -> Permit2, Permit2 -> router; returned when missing). The router returns no amount, so their simulation says only that the exact transaction executes.
Fee-on-transfer and other non-standard tokens can make the quoted amount unreachable.
V4 pools are quoted only without a hook, from pools.trade, or with a hook verified by a TOLLY hook registry (other hooks can game a quoter).
Route amounts are in the output token's ERC-20 units (amount_out_decimals); a native-USDC route's amount_out_min_raw and value are in 18 decimals.
price_impact_pct describes price_impact_route, the route that executes.

services.title: Market activity stream
services.semantics: A 10-minute live feed of Arc mainnet market events after the purchase: every swap on an indexed token/USDC market (side, USDC size, token amount, price, tx) and every new token/USDC market, and large transfers (tracked tokens worth >= $1,000, USDC >= $10,000), optionally filtered by tokens, kinds and minimum size. One purchase returns a ticket for GET /v1/streams/markets (Server-Sent Events); reconnects resume from Last-Event-ID until the ticket expires.

minUsd.description: Only swaps and transfers of at least this USD size.

successConditions: The ticket is accepted by the stream endpoint for the stated window.
Every delivered event is a mainnet log indexed by our live lane, with its block, log index and tx.
services.refundPolicy: If payment settles and no ticket can be delivered or recovered, the full price is refunded on chain.
services.redistribution: Buyer may use and redistribute the events; they are derived from public on-chain data.
limitations: Delivery is best-effort: events reach the stream within seconds of our indexer seeing them (it trails the chain head by a few blocks).
Missed events can be fetched again by reconnecting with Last-Event-ID while the ticket is valid; events are kept two hours.
At most 2 simultaneous connections per ticket.

Large transfers come from tokens whose holders we index (top traded, TOLLY pad tokens, tokens buyers asked about) and that have a token/USDC market with >= $10,000 of measured depth, plus USDC; they arrive within ~2 minutes (the holder lane's cadence) and may follow later swaps in event order.
Transfers exclude self-transfers, mints/burns, pool and pad legs, and any transfer in a transaction that also swapped; a token transfer's value counts only up to 10x its market's depth.
Swap sizes are the PoolManager/pool deltas: a hooked V4 pool's own fee or custom curve can make the trader's real amounts differ.
Events are indexed with a few blocks of confirmation; Arc has deterministic finality, so no retractions are sent.

services.title: Launch token (prepare)
services.semantics: Validates a TOLLY pad launch on Arc mainnet at least as strictly as the pad (banned names and symbols, required logo URI, field lengths, the dev-buy cap the token's anti-snipe max wallet imposes) and returns UNSIGNED transactions for the creator to sign: an optional USDC approval for the dev buy, then createToken with a fresh random salt. The launch is simulated from the creator at a pinned block, which gives the token address and a gas estimate. TOLLY never signs, deploys or holds anything for the buyer.

creator.description: The wallet that will sign and own the launch.

devBuyUsd.description: USDC the creator spends buying its own token in the launch transaction (at most 140: above ~150 the token's anti-snipe max wallet reverts the whole launch).

successConditions: The returned transactions call only the TOLLY pad and (for the dev buy) USDC, from and for the stated creator.
Parameters the pad would refuse (banned words, missing logo, oversize fields, a dev buy over the max wallet) are refused before any price is quoted.
services.refundPolicy: If payment settles and no result can be delivered or recovered, the full price is refunded on chain.
services.redistribution: Buyer may use the result freely.
limitations: The token address from the simulation holds only if the creator launches with this exact salt before anyone occupies that address; the pad then walks to the next free one.
The logo is not hosted or pinned by us: imageURI must already point to the image (https:// or ipfs://).
Paying for preparation authorizes nothing: only the creator's own signature launches the token, and the creator pays the gas.

services.title: Token price candles
services.semantics: OHLCV candles for one Arc mainnet token from every swap on one token/USDC market (the most traded one with at least $1,000 of USDC depth, or the named market): 5m/15m over the last 8 days, 1h/4h/1d/1w over up to a year of history. USD open/high/low/close, USDC volume and swap count. Intervals with no swap repeat the previous close (filled: true); intervals our history backfill has not fully reached yet are marked covered: false (values, if any, are partial; nothing is carried across them).

market.description: A V3 pool or V4 PoolId of this token; default: the token's price market.

hours.description: How far back. 5m/15m: at most 192 (8 days).

successConditions: Every candle is computed from indexed swaps of the stated market; uncovered intervals are marked, never invented.
services.refundPolicy: If payment settles and no result can be delivered or recovered, the full price is refunded on chain.
services.redistribution: Buyer may use and redistribute the result; it is derived from public on-chain data.
limitations: 5m/15m cover the last 8 days; 1h and longer cover up to a year, from the venues' start (Arc V3, Synthra, V4) once our one-off history backfill is complete (history.complete).
At most 1000 candles per call: 1h reaches ~41 days per call; 4h, 1d and 1w reach a year.
Prices are those of one token/USDC market (USDC = $1), not an average across markets.
5m/15m high/low are exact for buckets indexed after 2026-10-09 (hl_exact).

services.title: Token snapshots (batch)
services.semantics: Up to 50 Arc mainnet tokens in one call, each with: price from its most traded token/USDC market with at least $1,000 of USDC depth, 24 h change, market cap, measured liquidity, 24 h volume, market count, launch facts, holder summary (when fully indexed) and flags. Tokens we do not index are returned with indexed: false, never dropped.
successConditions: Every requested token appears once, in the requested order.
services.refundPolicy: If payment settles and no result can be delivered or recovered, the full price is refunded on chain.
services.redistribution: Buyer may use and redistribute the result; it is derived from public on-chain data.
limitations: Same coverage as token.intelligence: token/USDC markets on the indexed venues only.
Holder figures only for tokens whose full history is indexed; no tokens are queued by a batch.
Flags: valuation_over_10000x_liquidity, valuation_unverifiable (both on the price market, as in markets.search), no_deep_market, price_stale.
A token listed twice is refused (results are matched by position).

services.title: Wallet trades and PnL
services.semantics: One Arc mainnet wallet's trades over the last 1-8 days, reconstructed from its own Transfer logs (a transaction where it sent USDC and received exactly one token is a buy, the reverse a sell), with per-token quantities, USDC spent and received, average buy price, realized PnL on what it sold out of its window buys, and unrealized PnL of the rest at the current price.
successConditions: Every trade is a transaction of the stated window with a USDC leg and one token leg of this wallet.
services.refundPolicy: If payment settles and no result can be delivered or recovered, the full price is refunded on chain.
services.redistribution: Buyer may use and redistribute the result; it is derived from public on-chain data.
limitations: Window-limited: a sell realizes PnL only against tokens bought earlier in the window (running average cost); the rest is unmatched_sold, without PnL. The open quantity is capped at the wallet's balance now.
Token-for-token swaps (no USDC leg) and multi-token transactions are counted but not priced (coverage.token_swaps_skipped).
Gas (paid in USDC) is not included. Unrealized PnL uses the token's price market (>= $1,000 of USDC depth); open tokens without such a price are counted in unpriced_open_tokens, not valued.
Very busy wallets may get a partial window (coverage.partial).

services.title: Creator profile
services.semantics: A TOLLY pad creator's track record on Arc mainnet: how many tokens it launched and, for the 50 most recent, each token's price, market cap, liquidity, 24 h volume, its peak close over the last 8 days and the drawdown from it, whether it still trades, holder indexing status, and the share of supply the creator still holds (balanceOf at one block); plus totals and fixed-rule flags.
successConditions: Every launch is a TokenCreated event of the TOLLY V3 pad with this creator.
services.refundPolicy: If payment settles and no result can be delivered or recovered, the full price is refunded on chain.
services.redistribution: Buyer may use and redistribute the result; it is derived from public on-chain data.
limitations: Launches through the TOLLY V3 pad only; V4 pad and other launchpads are not covered yet.

Peak (highest 5-minute close) and drawdown cover the last 8 days, on the token's price market: the deep one (>= $1,000 USDC depth) or, failing that, its most traded market (price_basis: thin; market cap is then not stated).
Holders: indexing status only (use token.intelligence for holder metrics).
Market cap counts the whole supply; locked liquidity is not subtracted.
Flags are fixed rules over these numbers, not advice.

services.title: Alerts (24 h subscription)
services.semantics: A 24-hour subscription to up to 10 alert rules on Arc mainnet: a token's price crossing above/below a level, moving by a percentage within 1 h/24 h, swaps or transfers above a USD size, new token/USDC markets (optionally from one launchpad), and any token or USDC movement of a wallet. Matches are recorded within about a minute and are readable by polling with the returned token; with a webhook_url they are also POSTed there, signed (X-Tolly-Signature).

webhook_url.description: Public https URL to POST matches to (optional).

successConditions: The subscription is active for its whole window; every match is recorded and readable by polling.
services.refundPolicy: If payment settles and no subscription can be delivered or recovered, the full price is refunded on chain.
services.redistribution: Buyer may use and redistribute the alerts; they are derived from public on-chain data.
limitations: At most 500 matches per subscription (then it stops: status capped).

Price rules use the token's price market (>= $1,000 of USDC depth, traded in the last day; checked before payment) and fire once per crossing, re-arming when the condition stops holding; a condition already true at the start fires at once. The 1 h reference is the close 1-2 h ago (none if the market did not trade then).

Swap, transfer and new-market rules cover what our indexer streams: token/USDC markets; transfers >= $1,000 of tokens whose holders we index and >= $10,000 of USDC; new markets of any launchpad or the TOLLY pads. wallet_activity covers every token and native or ERC-20 USDC move of the wallet from the purchase on (infrastructure addresses are refused).
Matches arrive within about a minute (wallet activity within ~2 minutes). Webhooks are retried with backoff; after 20 consecutive failures delivery pauses (polling still works).

services.semantics: A 168-hour subscription to up to 10 alert rules on Arc mainnet: a token's price crossing above/below a level, moving by a percentage within 1 h/24 h, swaps or transfers above a USD size, new token/USDC markets (optionally from one launchpad), and any token or USDC movement of a wallet. services.refundPolicy: If payment settles and no subscription can be delivered or recovered, the full price is refunded on chain.
services.redistribution: Buyer may use and redistribute the alerts; they are derived from public on-chain data.
limitations: At most 2000 matches per subscription (then it stops: status capped).

Price rules use the token's price market (>= $1,000 of USDC depth, traded in the last day; checked before payment) and fire once per crossing, re-arming when the condition stops holding; a condition already true at the start fires at once. Matches arrive within about a minute (wallet activity within ~2 minutes). Webhooks are retried with backoff; after 20 consecutive failures delivery pauses (polling still works).
One wallet may hold at most 20 active subscriptions (checked before settlement; a refusal is not charged).
Market events are kept 2 hours: if our alerts worker is down longer than that, matches from the start of the outage can be missed (the subscription keeps running).
A subscription whose payment does not settle is cancelled.

services.title: Alerts (30 day subscription)
services.semantics: A 720-hour subscription to up to 10 alert rules on Arc mainnet: a token's price crossing above/below a level, moving by a percentage within 1 h/24 h, swaps or transfers above a USD size, new token/USDC markets (optionally from one launchpad), and any token or USDC movement of a wallet. Matches are recorded within about a minute and are readable by polling with the returned token; with a webhook_url they are also POSTed there, signed (X-Tolly-Signature).

webhook_url.description: Public https URL to POST matches to (optional).

successConditions: The subscription is active for its whole window; every match is recorded and readable by polling.
services.refundPolicy: If payment settles and no subscription can be delivered or recovered, the full price is refunded on chain.
services.redistribution: Buyer may use and redistribute the alerts; they are derived from public on-chain data.
limitations: At most 5000 matches per subscription (then it stops: status capped).

Price rules use the token's price market (>= $1,000 of USDC depth, traded in the last day; checked before payment) and fire once per crossing, re-arming when the condition stops holding; a condition already true at the start fires at once. The 1 h reference is the close 1-2 h ago (none if the market did not trade then).

Swap, transfer and new-market rules cover what our indexer streams: token/USDC markets; transfers >= $1,000 of tokens whose holders we index and >= $10,000 of USDC; new markets of any launchpad or the TOLLY pads. wallet_activity covers every token and native or ERC-20 USDC move of the wallet from the purchase on (infrastructure addresses are refused).
Matches arrive within about a minute (wallet activity within ~2 minutes). Webhooks are retried with backoff; after 20 consecutive failures delivery pauses (polling still works).
One wallet may hold at most 20 active subscriptions (checked before settlement; a refusal is not charged).
Market events are kept 2 hours: if our alerts worker is down longer than that, matches from the start of the outage can be missed (the subscription keeps running).
A subscription whose payment does not settle is cancelled.

services.title: Alerts renewal (+24 h)
services.semantics: Extends an alerts subscription by 24 hours and 500 more matches, for its holder (subscription id and token). An expired or capped subscription restarts from the moment of renewal with its rules and webhook unchanged (price rules re-armed, a paused webhook resumed); matches during the gap are not replayed. Cancelled subscriptions cannot be renewed.
successConditions: The subscription's window ends 24 h later than before (or 24 h from now if it had ended).
services.refundPolicy: If payment settles and the renewal cannot be applied or recovered, the full price is refunded on chain.
services.redistribution: Not applicable.
limitations: A subscription is never extended beyond 31 days ahead (checked before payment).
Renewing does not change rules or the webhook; buy a new subscription for other rules.
Restarting a stopped subscription needs free alerts capacity (checked before payment); a renewal whose payment does not settle is taken back.

services.title: Token research bundle
services.semantics: Everything an agent needs to judge one Arc mainnet token, in one call: the full token.intelligence.v3 report (price, market cap, markets, pools against other tokens, launch, holders), the token.risk.v2 report (contract powers, proxies, hooks, concentration, rule-based notes), token.ohlcv.v2 candles for the last 24 hours (1h) and 30 days (1d), and the token.pairs.v1 pools against other tokens. Each part is exactly what its own service returns; parts that cannot be produced are null with a reason.
successConditions: Each part equals what its own service would return at the same time (holders are computed once and shared by both reports); at least the intelligence report is present.
services.refundPolicy: If payment settles and no result can be delivered or recovered, the full price is refunded on chain.
services.redistribution: Buyer may use and redistribute the result; it is derived from public on-chain data.
limitations: Same coverage and limits as token.intelligence.v3, token.risk.v2, token.ohlcv.v2 and token.pairs.v1.

Intelligence and risk get up to 8 s, then the candles, then the pairs, with what is left; a part that fails or runs out of time is null (listed in errors with a reason code) and the rest is still delivered at the full price. Without the intelligence report the call fails and is not charged.

services.title: Token holders history
services.semantics: Holder count, top-1 and top-10 share and HHI (0-10,000) of one Arc mainnet token at the end of each UTC day, for up to the last 365 days (today: so far). Same holder definition as token.intelligence.v2: positive balances, excluding burn addresses, the V4 PoolManager, the TOLLY pads, the token itself and its own pools; shares are of what those holders hold. Days before our live tracking began come from one replay of the token's whole Transfer history, served only after it added up exactly to totalSupply.
successConditions: One point per day from the later of the window start and the first day we have, to today; every point is our recorded state of that day, or the previous recorded state when that day has no record (carried: true).
services.refundPolicy: If payment settles and no result can be delivered or recovered, the full price is refunded on chain.
services.redistribution: Buyer may use and redistribute the result; it is derived from public on-chain data.
limitations: Sold only for tokens whose holders we index (checked before payment). A token gets indexed when it is among the most traded, is a TOLLY pad launch, or someone buys token.intelligence.v2 for it.

Until the replay of a token's earlier history has been verified, history is "rebuilding" and points start where live tracking began; if the replay cannot be verified (reflection, rebasing or non-standard tokens) history is "unavailable" before that day.
A day's point is the last state we recorded during that UTC day by our clock (live rows are refreshed about every 30 minutes, so it can miss the day's last transfers); today's point is so far.
carried: true means no record for that day: before live tracking began, the token had no transfers that day; after, our indexer was not recording (outage or lag), and the previous state is repeated.

services.title: Token pairs (prices and volume against other tokens)
services.semantics: The pools in which one Arc mainnet token trades against another token (not USDC) on the Arc V3 and Synthra factories and the V4 PoolManager (up to 50; by guarded 24 h USD volume, then 24 h swap count, then last swap): each pool's price in the counter token after its last swap, the USD price that implies through the counter token's own USDC market and its deviation from the token's direct USD price, and 24 h swaps and volume of each leg, in USD only when both legs' USD values agree.
successConditions: Every listed pool is a pool of this token against another token on an indexed venue; prices and volumes are those recorded from its swaps.
services.refundPolicy: If payment settles and no result can be delivered or recovered, the full price is refunded on chain.
services.redistribution: Buyer may use and redistribute the result; it is derived from public on-chain data.
limitations: Sold for tokens with their own token/USDC market in our index (checked before payment).

A pool's price is its last swap's; a pool that has not traded since we began recording pair swaps (volume_since) has no price. implied_usd_price is null when that swap is older than 24 h or the counter token has no USD price.

USD prices come only from a token's own USDC market with at least $1,000 of measured depth, at their current price. A pool's USD volume is stated only when both legs are priced that way and agree within 10% (each leg summed separately; a pool priced off the market by wash trading gets none).

Swap counts and volumes include wash trading; for V4 pools with hooks, Swap event amounts exclude hook fees and hook-taken deltas. 24 h figures cover less than 24 h while volume_window_complete is false.
No liquidity depth for these pools; a thin pool's price can be far from the market (see deviation_pct).
